##### Project general facts

Masaar 3 Dalia by Arada is the seventh phase of the forested Masaar community, conceived as a family neighbourhood integrated into a green oasis with walking paths and relaxation areas. Contemporary minimalist architecture with clean volumes, panoramic glazing and a restrained palette harmonises with the landscape. The collection offers townhouses with two, three and four bedrooms and standalone four-bedroom villas, each rising over ground and first floors, with the villas adding a roof level.

Residents enjoy access to the distinctive lifestyle of the wider community, with a strong focus on wellness, recreation and outdoor activity. Swimming pools, sports courts, tree-lined walking and cycling routes and landscaped open spaces create opportunities for morning runs, evening strolls and time spent in nature, while play areas, cafes and community facilities provide places for family activities, relaxation and social interaction close to home.

Interiors feature high ceilings, quality finishes and an emphasis on natural light, with layouts designed for comfortable family living. Homes include private gardens, balconies, covered parking, a maid's room and storage, with smart home technology and premium fittings throughout, while selected villas add private offices. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances including a cooking range, a hood and a washer-dryer, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each home easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Masaar is a forested master-planned community in Sharjah, where homes are set among tree-lined green corridors, parks and shaded walking and cycling paths. Community pools, sports courts, play areas, cafes, a mosque and a community centre create a calm, family-oriented setting, while Masaar Central adds retail, dining and everyday services within easy reach of every neighbourhood.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Masaar Central, Tilal Mall, Nasma Central Park and the Sharjah Mosque are a short drive away, while Sharjah International Airport, University City and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, along with schools, clinics and hospitals serving local families.

Masaar is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the best-selling green residential destinations in the UAE. Spacious villas and townhouses surrounded by nature attract families seeking more space at accessible prices compared with Dubai. Low service charges, an established community and strong road links support steady demand from end users and tenants, underpinning long-term value for owners and investors.
